verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs, such as recurring reports or syncs, is a fair question for an equity-management SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only user-initiated document workflows (board consents, convertible notes, board changes) and event-driven automation (data room auto-filing, Gusto sync). Predefined vesting schedules are an equity-terms feature, not job scheduling, so none of this documents a way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows.
